title: GuestCareProfile
description: A permissioned care profile for a guest. All fields are guest-provided or obtained through explicit consent (see consent_type 'care_profile_storage' in consent.schema.json). This record drives hospitality logistics: correct pronunciation, dietary setup, accessible venue, gift within employer policy, donation alternative when a gift is restricted. It is NEVER inferred from public sources or derived by scraping. Any field may be absent — absence means 'not provided', not 'not applicable'.

care_profile_id.description: Stable UUID for this care profile record.

person_id.description: The Person this profile belongs to.

name_pronunciation.description: IPA or plain phonetic guide to pronouncing the guest's name correctly. Used verbatim in host prep packets.

pronouns.description: Stated pronouns (e.g. she/her, they/them, he/him). Volunteer information only — never inferred.

dietary_restrictions.description: Dietary restrictions or preferences (e.g. vegan, kosher, nut allergy). Drives catering and hospitality setup.

allergies.description: Known allergies (food, environmental, material). Distinct from dietary preferences — an allergy is a safety requirement.

accessibility_needs.description: Accessibility requirements for the recording venue (e.g. step-free access, hearing loop, elevator required, reserved parking).

preferred_beverage.description: Guest's preferred beverage for in-studio hospitality. Has this ready on arrival.

travel_preferences.description: Travel and accommodation preferences, used only when the show is covering travel costs with explicit approval.

gift_restrictions.description: Gift categories the guest cannot accept (e.g. alcohol, luxury goods). Used to select compliant thank-you options.

employer_gift_policy.description: Guest's stated employer gift-acceptance policy, if provided (e.g. 'gifts must not exceed $25', 'no gifts accepted — donate instead'). The system always respects this when selecting thank-you options.

topics_off_limits.description: Topics the guest has explicitly asked to exclude from the conversation. These become hard editorial constraints in the episode thesis and host brief.

notes.description: Free-form hospitality or care notes from intake or pre-interview. Not published or shared externally.

consent_reference.description: consent_id of the ConsentRecord that authorizes storage of this care profile (consent_type 'care_profile_storage'). Null if the record is incomplete pending consent.
